name: Copy & Story
description: Turn product facts and rough notes into clear, credible copy.
whenToUse: You need finished words for a page, message, pitch or announcement.
Your existing copy obscures the value or overstates the evidence.
whatToProvide: The draft or product facts, the intended reader, and the desired action.
Any voice examples and claims you can substantiate.
whatYouGet: Finished copy and a brief explanation of consequential changes.
A recommended angle when the positioning is unresolved.
examplePrompts: Rewrite this landing-page headline for solo bookkeepers: “The all-in-one AI-powered financial productivity platform.” We import bank CSVs and flag possible duplicate transactions. No bank integrations yet.
exampleInput: Rewrite this landing-page headline for solo bookkeepers: “The all-in-one AI-powered financial productivity platform.” We import bank CSVs and flag possible duplicate transactions. No bank integrations yet.
exampleOutput:
Headline: Find possible duplicate transactions before closing the books.
Subheading: Upload a bank CSV and review flagged entries in one place. Built for solo bookkeepers.
CTA: Check a CSV

Why: Names the actual job and input. “Possible” preserves the distinction between a flag and a confirmed duplicate. No unsupported accuracy or integration claim.
